It passed under the proposal's own 30% quorum rule; the Snapshot space's 3B quorum was not met, so the pass is disputed. The proposal says MIM is senior to SPELL and "SPELL token does not retain any accounting value" until MIM is repaid in full; recoveries go to MIM holders and borrowers, and SPELL holders get nothing.
